page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.8xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs based on the Intel Xeon 8269CY processor, operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio position this instance as a resource-dense option for compute-heavy workloads that do not require massive memory footprints or integrated GPU acceleration.

Given its hardware profile, the ecs.c6t.8xlarge is suited for compute-intensive applications. Appropriate workloads include batch processing, high-performance web serving, distributed analytics, and application servers that benefit from dedicated Intel Xeon processing power without requiring local storage or high memory-to-CPU ratios.
